# St Joseph's Curriculum Portal — LLM & Edge Inference Map

> Deterministic, 0-dependency developing-world teaching aid running via Native Web Standards (**Vite `^8.3.6`**, **TypeScript `^5.6.3`**, Zero React), Chrome Prompt API (Gemini Nano), WebLLM, the autonomous `<35 KB` AST Vector Media Engine (v2.6.0), and a separate Procedural 3D BSL/Makaton In-Vision Avatar (`<native-bsl-interpreter>`). Interactive architecture Show & Tell document available at `/docs/lumina-architecture.ast` (`/player?preset=lumina-architecture`). The AST player serves a dual-market architecture: perpetually free for schools and humanitarian commons (Track A), and commercially licensed for enterprise Digital Signage (DOOH), Programmatic Display Advertising, and Interactive Kiosks (Track B).

## Core Portal Endpoints & Route Map
- [Portal Home](/) - Overview, Quick Starters, and Subject Hub

- [EYFS & KS1 Phonics Sounds Suite](/phonics) - DfE Phases 2–5 soundboard, sound buttons blending mat, Alien Words screening check & flashcards
- [MFL & Polyglot Languages Studio](/languages) - Spanish, French & Latin comparative phonics, verb wheels, etymology bridges & vocab sprints

- [Shakespeare Globe Theatre Suite](/shakespeare) - 1599 Wooden O 3D stage geometry, 5-Act dramatic play-throughs, spoken blank verse & metronomes

- [First Holy Communion](/first-communion) - Catechetical sacraments explorer and liturgical preparation

- [Neural Settings](/settings) - Hardware probe, WebGPU status, Chrome Prompt API toggle

- [Dual-Licensing Charter & Covenant](/licensing) - Track A Humanitarian Commons GNU AGPLv3/OGLv3 vs Track B Enterprise Commercial License

- [Child Safety Policy](/child-safety) - Strict safeguarding standards, local AI inference, and student data protection
- [Autonomous Agent Directory](/agents.txt) - Machine-readable tools, permissions, and W3C WebMCP discovery

## Architectural Overview & Engine Upgrades
- **Zero Cloud Leakage & Zero Server Data**: The site holds 0 student or user data on remote servers. All logs, answers, voice inputs, and progress records remain exclusively within client-side IndexedDB (`services/dbStore.ts`, `services/jotter-db.ts`).
- **Single-Cycle FMA Math Compiler & 6-Float Matrix Vectorization**: Built-in AST Math Compiler (`astMathCompiler.ts`) automatically extracts linear affine relationships (m*t + c) and compiles transforms to direct 6-element homogeneous affine matrices (`matrix(a, b, c, d, e, f)`). Pre-allocated flat buffers evaluate in single-cycle FMA math with zero dynamic heap allocations, 1.7× faster 60 FPS frame loops, and zero JIT micro-compiles on scene mount.
- **Multi-Modal Synchronized Tuples**: Full multi-modal tuple binding: `[AST Vector Stage + Synchronized Video Underlay/Overlay + Procedural Web Audio Synth + S-Expression Reactive Data-Flow + Sub-pixel Pointer Gestures + Formative Assessment Checkpoints]`. Video and vector playback are locked to a single master clock with configurable `video-fit` ("contain" | "cover"), frame-accurate timeline scrubbing, and reactive HUD overlays that dynamically bind to video timestamps.
- **Decoupled, Domain-Agnostic Flash-Caliber Engine (<35 KB gzipped)**: The AST Vector Engine (`@stjosephs/ast-vector-player`) is fully decoupled from host frameworks (built with Native Web Standards & Web Components) and purged of hardcoded scene logic. It runs with 0 external runtime dependencies, sub-15 ms cold start, and <8 MB RAM. It features dynamic parameter and selector HUD auto-discovery (`setupSimParametersHud`), which automatically parses `:inputs`, `:vars`, numerical bounds, step sizes, labels, and selector controls (such as DNA base-pair unzipping and nucleotides, kinetic gas pressure valves, electric circuit switches, calculus tangent probes, or DOOH commercial dials) for ANY scene or domain.
- **In-Stage Performance Profiler & Diagnostics HUD**: Built-in vector `ASTProfiler` (`SET_PERF_HUD`, `TOGGLE_PERF_HUD`, `?hud=1`) rendering real-time rolling sparklines, sub-0.2 ms AST VM compute measurement, and frame budget headroom (99% headroom @ 60 FPS), with a dedicated `⚡ Diagnostics` drawer displaying WASM 7-page linear memory pool utilization.
- **High-Performance AST Binary Bytecode (.astb)**: Vector scenes can be compiled and streamed as ultra-dense binary bytecode (`.astb`) via `src/utils/astBytecode.ts` and `ast-engine.js`. The zero-allocation binary reader decodes opcodes for stages, reactive bindings, 3D meshes, keyframes, computed expressions, state machines, and emitters with sub-millisecond parsing and a 99.8% size reduction over legacy web bundles.
- **On-Device Edge AI & Gemini Nano Synergy**: Powered by the Chrome Prompt API (`window.LanguageModel`) and local WebLLM. This pairing is historically unique: while generative models struggle to output 2–5 MB of imperative JavaScript (e.g. PhET bundles) at runtime, they can generate 1–4 KB declarative AST S-Expressions constrained by GBNF grammar (`ast-sexpr.gbnf` / `ast-scene.gbnf`) in ~500 ms with mathematical syntax guarantees. Students receive instant, personalized pedagogical hints and formative scaffolds completely offline with zero cloud data egress.
- **Universal Translator & Multilingual Voice/Subtitles**: Procedural speech synthesis and bilingual subtitles in English, Spanish, French, Latin, German, and Italian, perfectly locked to AST keyframe intervals.
- **Procedural 3D British Sign Language (BSL) In-Vision Interpreter**: World-first zero-video procedural 3D signing engine (11.3 KB gzipped for the entire 68-sign primary curriculum corpus, ~170 bytes/sign, 99.99% video bandwidth reduction). Operates via declarative AST S-Expressions (`/lexicons/bsl-signs.ast`) with 3D coordinate tuples `(:xyz [x y z])` and 60 FPS cubic Hermite spline interpolation. Features native dual-hand coordination modes (`:mirror` for bilateral symmetry, `:vowel-board` for 5-finger manual tap palettes, and `:base-shift` for independent base hand spatial anchors), grammatical Non-Manual Features (NMF procedural facial morphemes for eyebrows, mouth shapes, and head tilts), interactive 360° drag-to-orbit camera for inspecting knuckle and thumb depth, W3C Document Picture-in-Picture (PiP), universal keyboard shortcut `Shift + B`, and real-time speech boundary event bus synchronization across every player on the portal (`bslGlobalStore`).
- **Oak National Academy Curriculum Code Mapping**: Full synchronous alignment between Oak curriculum codes and AST cartridges. 20 Oak Religious Education units (`OAK-KS2-RE-001` through `020` and KS3 units) are synchronously registered in the player catalog (`static/player/ast-registry.js` and `scenes.manifest.json`), mapping directly to dedicated Catholic Life 3D vector cartridges without broken links or 404 fallbacks.
- **Smartboard & Stylus Pen Overlay**: Native in-stage whiteboard ink layer (`#annotation-ink-root`) with quadratic Bézier smoothing for Promethean, SMART, ViewSonic, and iPad stylus pens.
- **Pedagogical X-Ray & Sonification**: `data-pedagogical` discovery inspection across science, math, and liturgical architecture with zero-asset mathematical Web Audio synthesis.
- **PhET & Legacy Flash Transpiler Bridge (`ast-phet-bridge.js` & `phetBridge.ts`)**: Distills 12 MB legacy PhET HTML5/JSON bundles and Flash SWFs down into <4 KB AST S-Expressions (99.8% payload reduction) while preserving physical conservation laws, zero-asset Web Audio, and SCORM auto-reporting.
- **Discrete Tri-System Architecture & Pure Gesture VM (`ast-gestures.js`)**: Built on **Vite `^8.3.6`** (Rolldown / esbuild `^0.28.1`) and **TypeScript `^5.6.3`** (Zero React), the host portal, `< 35 KB` AST Vector Player (v2.6.0), and Procedural BSL Avatar (`NativeBslInterpreter.ts`) remain cleanly decoupled. `ast-engine.js` and `ast-gestures.js` form a 100% generic Virtual Machine executing declarative `:draggable`, `:clickable`, `:holdable`, and `:key` press-and-hold `requestAnimationFrame` loops without scene-specific JS.
- **W3C WebMCP Native Agent Tool Registry**: Implements the W3C Web Machine Learning Community Group WebMCP specification via `document.modelContext.registerTool(...)` (`services/webMcpBridge.ts`), exposing typed client-side tools (`catholic_catechism_search`, `navigate_portal`, `launch_simulation`, `list_ast_simulations`, `get_learner_status`) for browser AI agents without DOM scraping or computer vision fragility.
- **Decoupled 4-Way Distribution**: The engine distributes across four universal formats: (1) Headless npm package (`@stjosephs/ast-vector-player` v2.6.0); (2) Standalone Sandbox (`/player.html?preset=...` or `?src=/docs/lumina-architecture.ast`); (3) Embeddable responsive LMS iframe (`/player/index.html?preset=...`) with bidirectional `postMessage` telemetry; and (4) Single-file air-gapped HTML bundle (`<45 KB`) running from `file://` or USB thumb drives.
- **Fantasy Console & Lisp Machine Paradigm ("Lisp as the Substrate / Oil")**: The entire simulator, curriculum bank, and accessibility engine runs on a strict Lisp Machine architecture. The player runtime (`ast-engine.js`, `ast-compiler.js`, WASM linear memory pool) acts as the bare-metal kernel. The cartridge (`.ast`, `.lisp`, and pre-compiled `.astb` bytecode) is 100% pure Lisp code (S-expressions). TypeScript/JavaScript does not invent or hardcode simulation buttons, sliders, or UI in templates; instead, cartridges declare `(ui:controls (control:button ...) (control:toggle ...) (control:slider ...) (control:select ...))` as first-class AST nodes. When a cartridge mounts, the player runtime's AST walker (`projectControls`) dynamically projects controls into the in-stage glass overlay (`⚡ LISP UI`), binding sliders and toggles directly into the S-expression evaluator's linear memory environment and mapping actions via an action dispatch table (`(sim:reset)`, `(player:toggle-bsl)`).
- **Two-Handed BSL Level 6 Linguistic Syntax in Lisp**: The procedural 3D British Sign Language (BSL) and Makaton interpreter operates directly from declarative Lisp codebooks (`static/lexicons/bsl-codebook.lisp`) and AST sign dictionaries (`static/lexicons/bsl-signs.ast`). Directional agreement verbs ($\vec{v}(t) = \vec{L}_{dest} - \vec{L}_{src}$), 10-point spatial registers, aspectual modulators, and polycomponential handshape predicates evaluate through the unified S-expression grammar at 60 FPS with zero video streaming costs.
- **Cross-Industry DOOH & AdTech Ready (Track B)**: Meets strict IAB display advertising weight limits (<45 KB total ad weight vs 150 KB cap), runs 24/7 on low-power quad-core ARM chips (Raspberry Pi, Android 11 sticks, LG webOS, Samsung Tizen) with <8 MB RAM, scales infinitely from 2-inch shelf labels to 100-ft 8K billboards with zero pixelation, and executes Dynamic Creative Optimization (DCO) over `postMessage`.

## Complete Production Curriculum Cartridge Catalog (68 Cartridges)

### Mathematics & Quantitative Reasoning
1. [Calculus: Tangent Slopes & Integrals](/curriculum/maths/calculus/tangent-slopes) (`calculus-curves`) - Tangent slope dy/dx, stationary turning points, and Riemann Simpson's 1/3 numerical integrals.
2. [Algebra Balance Scale Lab](/curriculum/maths/algebra/balance-scale) (`algebra-balance`) - Two-pan balance scale, algebraic equation balancing (2x + 5 = 15), and zero-pair cancelations.
3. [Pythagoras' Geometric Proof](/curriculum/maths/geometry/pythagoras) (`pythagoras`) - Euclidean shear proof, dynamic square slicing, area conservation, and algebraic a² + b² = c² verification.
4. [BODMAS / BIDMAS Forcefield Clamping](/curriculum/maths/algebra/bodmas) (`bodmas`) - Visual operation precedence clamps, bracket forcefields, and step-by-step arithmetic evaluations.
5. [Fraction Wall & Slicing](/curriculum/maths/arithmetic/fractions) (`fractions`) - Visual fraction wall, dynamic denominator slicing, equivalent fractions, and common denominator arithmetic.
6. [Times Tables 2D Multiplication Array](/curriculum/maths/arithmetic/times-tables) (`times-tables`) - 2× to 12× multiplication arrays, distributive property slicing, and commutative proofs.
7. [Maths Fishing: Number Bonds to 10/20](/curriculum/maths/arithmetic/number-bonds) (`math-fishing`) - Gamified number bond rods, hook physics, and complementary addition calculations.

### Physics, Chemistry, Computing & Design & Technology
8. [Kinetic Gas Theory & Boyle's Law](/curriculum/science/physics/kinetic-gas) (`kinetic-gas`) - Molecular gas dynamics, Boyle's Law PV = nRT, Gay-Lussac's Law, wall impulse pressure gauge, and solid/liquid/gas phase changes.
9. [Electrical Circuits Lab & Ohm's Law](/curriculum/science/physics/electric-circuits) (`electric-circuits`) - Interactive knife switches, Ohm's law V = IR, series/parallel branches, and live ammeter/voltmeter readouts.
10. [Bohr Atomic Structure & Electron Shells](/curriculum/science/chemistry/atomic-structure) (`atom`) - 2,8,8 orbital electron configurations, atomic number vs mass, and 3D shell inclination tilt.
11. [Kinematics: Velocity & Distance-Time Vectors](/curriculum/science/physics/velocity-vectors) (`velocity`) - Distance-time and velocity-time graphs with synchronized vector sprites and acceleration vectors.
12. [Solar System 3D Heliocentric Orbits](/curriculum/science/physics/solar-system) (`solar-system`) - Heliocentric planetary orbits, Keplerian velocities, axial tilts, and 3D inclination angles.
13. [BBC Micro Model B & MOS 6502 Architecture](/curriculum/computing/bbc-micro) (`bbc-micro`) - Sophie Wilson 1981 Acorn MOS 6502 system, 54-key matrix, SAA5050 Ceefax teletext Mode 7 overlay, and native CRT phosphor scanline optics.
14. [Inverted Pendulum & Cart-Pole LQR Balance](/curriculum/computing/cart-pole) (`cart-pole`) - Deterministic continuous 60 FPS state-space feedback control, real-time telemetry HUD, and kinematic disturbance injection.
15. [Modular Brick Engineering & 3D Spatial Geometry](/curriculum/design-technology/lego-blocks) (`lego-blocks`) - KS2/KS3 Design & Technology 8.0 mm modular pitch matrix, 3D isometric turntable, internal friction clutch tubes, and staggered shear bonding.
16. [Vector Racing Kinematic Physics Lab](/player?preset=vector-racing) (`vector-racing`) - Real-time velocity, steering drag, and continuous press-and-hold `:key` / `:clickable` controls.

### Biology & Earth Sciences
17. [DNA Watson-Crick Double Helix & Transcription](/curriculum/science/biology/dna-helix) (`dna-helix`) - Hydrogen-bonded base pairing (A-T, C-G) in 3D projected helical twist with interactive unzipping and transcription controls.
18. [Photosynthesis Solar Engine](/curriculum/science/biology/photosynthesis) (`photosynthesis`) - Chloroplast inner thylakoids, light-dependent reactions, Calvin cycle, and carbon dioxide absorption.
19. [Water Cycle Continuous Earth Engine](/curriculum/geography/water-cycle) (`water-cycle`) - Evaporation, transpiration, condensation, precipitation, and percolation cycle.
20. [Mountain Elevation & Atmospheric Science](/curriculum/geography/mountain-elevation) (`mountain-elevation`) - Altitude hypotenuse, clinometer elevation angles, and atmospheric boiling point shifts.
21. [Aquarium Living Ecosystem Stress Benchmark](/curriculum/computing/stress-benchmark) (`fish-tank`) - Vector stress benchmark, multi-species aquatic food web, nitrogen cycle, and water chemistry parameters.

### Early Literacy, Phonics & English Language Arts

42. [The Liturgy of the Hours (Divine Office)](/curriculum/catholic-life/liturgy-of-the-hours) (`liturgy-of-the-hours`) - Sanctification of daily time through Matins, Lauds, Terce, Sext, None, Vespers, and Compline.
43. [The Nicene & Apostles' Creed](/curriculum/catholic-life/nicene-creed) (`nicene-creed`) - Systematic exploration of the Credo in Unum Deum, Trinitarian theology, Christology, and Four Marks of the Church.
44. [The Ten Commandments & Moral Law](/curriculum/catholic-life/ten-commandments) (`ten-commandments`) - The Decalogue on the Two Tablets of Sinai, love of God and neighbor, and Catholic moral theology.

47. [The 24 Catholic Rites & Churches](/curriculum/catholic-life/catholic-rites) (`catholic-rites`) - Universal communion across Western Latin Rite and Eastern Catholic Rites (Byzantine, Alexandrian, Antiochene, Armenian, Chaldean).
48. [Catholic Social Teaching & Gospel Virtues](/curriculum/catholic-life/cst-virtues) (`cst-virtues`) - Seven principles of CST (Human Dignity, Subsidiarity, Common Good, Option for the Poor, Solidarity) and theological/cardinal virtues.

## Model Consumption & Generation Guidelines
- **Zero Cloud Egress**: Student logs, answers, and evaluations must stay on client-side IndexedDB.
- **Strict Grammar Validation**: Validate all generated S-Expressions against `/player/grammar/ast-sexpr.gbnf`.
- **Declarative Tuple Composition**: When composing interactive lessons or slides, declare multi-modal tuples containing vector keyframes, reactive bindings, sound sonification hooks, and formative assessment gates.
- **Coordinate Space Invariant**: Standardize on `<svg viewBox="0 0 800 480">` with responsive element IDs matching `:bindings` declarations.
- **Dynamic Parameters**: Emit `:inputs` and `:vars` blocks with explicit `:label`, `:min`, `:max`, `:step`, and `:default` properties to trigger the engine's generic parameter HUD automatically without custom JavaScript.
- **Scene Execution Typology**: Always declare the correct `:type` in the root `(:scene ...)` tag:
  - `:type "Sim"` for continuous $\Delta t$ dynamic integration (kinematics, pendulums, orbits, gas laws).
  - `:type "Slide"` for discrete conceptual inspection decks (CST virtues, liturgical postures, grammar rubrics) without a runaway clock.
  - `:type "Film"` for strictly monotonic timeline choreography ($t \in [0.0, 1.0]$) bound to audio or video duration.
- **Token Efficiency**: Rely on concise AST S-Expressions rather than prose; S-Expressions consume 75% fewer tokens and execute deterministically at 60 FPS in native SVG.
## Real-World Thermodynamic & Grid-Scale Footprint (Scope 3 Avoidance)

The architectural discipline of the St Joseph's Engine (sub-35 KB runtime, 448 KB WASM linear memory pool, local neural execution) eliminates the hidden thermodynamic and physical supply-chain costs incurred by cloud-tethered EdTech and remote hyperscaler inference:

### 1. Avoided Data-Center Freshwater Evaporation
- **Cloud LLM Baseline:** Data centers consume an estimated **0.3 to 0.5 mL of potable freshwater per query** via industrial evaporative cooling towers to cool high-density accelerator clusters (H100/TPU racks).
- **St Joseph's Invariant:** **0.00 mL / query.** All generative Socratic hints, misconception checks, and evaluation steps run purely on-device via local NPU/GPU/CPU silicon (Chromium Prompt API / WebLLM) or deterministic AST rulebooks. Zero municipal water is evaporated across regional watersheds.

### 2. Upstream Grid Peak Draw & Peaker-Plant Avoidance
- **Remote Cloud API Toll:** A standard cloud-hosted Socratic interaction typically consumes **0.3 to 2.5 Watt-hours (Wh)** (1,000 to 9,000 Joules) when accounting for server draw, network hops, router switching, and facility Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE).
- **Synchronized Classroom Spikes:** Concurrent 9:00 AM school starts create instantaneous grid surges that are frequently balanced by fossil-fueled peaker plants supplying remote data halls.
- **Avoided Grid Overhead:** Sparing ~1.0 Wh per query across a standard trust of **1,000 pupils completing 30 daily interactions** eliminates **~30 kWh/day (~5.7 MWh/school year)** of external grid demand.

### 3. Client Battery Chemistry & Silicon Preservation
- **Unconstrained Canvas Baselines:** Monolithic HTML5/canvas engines (e.g. PhET, commercial LMS widgets) run continuous, unthrottled `requestAnimationFrame` loops consuming 100% of a CPU core, drawing **8 to 15 Watts** on budget laptops and inducing thermal throttling within 20 minutes.
- **Dirty-State RAF Cancellation:** The AST engine halts animation ticks entirely when the stage reaches equilibrium, dropping incremental processor draw to **< 0.2 Watts (< 0.5% CPU)** while reading or thinking.
- **Audio Thread Suspension:** The procedural Web Audio synthesizer auto-suspends (`audioCtx.suspend()`) after 300 ms of silence, cutting audio thread drain by up to 15%.
- **Operational Endurance:** Extends battery runtime from ~2.5–3.0 hours to **6.0–8.0+ hours** on standard 40 Wh Chromebooks, directly halving battery thermal degradation and reducing premature e-waste replacements.

### 4. Flash Storage (eMMC) Wear Guard
- **Continuous I/O Thrashing Baseline:** Conventional web platforms continuously write telemetry, caching chunks, and tracking state to disk, rapidly exhausting the limited program-erase (P/E) cycles of low-cost eMMC flash memory in budget educational hardware.
- **Milestone-Gated Persistence:** The AST engine performs **strictly 0 disk writes/second during active simulation manipulation**. State is maintained in volatile `Float32Array` buffers and only flushed asynchronously to IndexedDB upon discrete pedagogical milestones (e.g., question completion, badge award) with a 500 ms trailing debounce.
